headline: Obama order sets the line of officials who would temporarily lead the Environmental Protection Agency if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which EPA officials, in what order, would act as head of the agency if the Administrator and Deputy Administrator die, resign, or are otherwise unable to do the job. It is an internal planning rule meant to keep the agency running without a gap in leadership. No abstract was provided, so details beyond the title are not confirmed.

who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are named in a set order to step in temporarily as acting head of the agency if needed.
